title: AI could pose ‘whole problem’ for management education, CEA Nageswaran warns
description: Artificial intelligence poses a fundamental challenge to management education over upcoming decades. Young professionals traditionally develop experience and judgement through entry-level work. AI is automating these routine tasks, which are crucial for learning. Business schools must teach judgement, not just technical skills, to prepare students. Social media also fragments attention and strains young people's health.
